screens.name: Which number do I need? (number step)
screens.purpose: Choose the right series for your calls and sector, and see documents, time and price before any credential is asked.
screens.layout: Step 1 and step 2 as large tap-cards. Result: one recommendation card with a 'Why' line, four columns (documents, time, price, carriers) and Start. The chat dock mirrors the same questions in Hinglish.
elements: Q1 'Aap kis tarah ke calls karenge?': Service (renewal, EMI due, appointment) · Transactional (order, delivery) · Promotional (offers; consented leads, coming in v2)
Q2 'Aapka business?': Insurance intermediary · NBFC/Bank · Mutual fund · Pension · Utility · Logistics · Other
Result: '1600-series line. Why: IRDAI entities must call from 1600 for service calls, even with consent.'
Documents: PE registration on DLT (about INR 5,900) · Certificate of incorporation, GSTIN, PAN · IRDAI registration certificate · Authorised-signatory letter
Time: 'about 7-14 business days'
Price: 'Per-minute price: not published by any carrier. We'll get you a quote.'
Meanwhile: 'Browser and verified-phone tests keep working.'
states: Sector not regulated: recommends a declared 10-digit line with a spam-flag note
Promotional chosen: 'Promotional calls need consent records and a 140 line; available in wave 2'
Small-BFSI exemption (if TRAI issues one): 1600 optional, with a 10-digit fallback and a warning
Unknown price or time shown as unknown, never as a guess
screens.beats: No incumbent states series, documents, time and price before credentials. Retell asks for a government ID before any country; ElevenLabs asks 7 provider fields with Singapore as the default region; Bolna shows its India gate only as an error after the country choice.

comparison.their_best: Rent via Vobiz beside bring-your-own with 7 providers; Bolna lists KYC documents before the click and verifies each number on Truecaller
comparison.vp_better_how: A series chosen from category and sector, with documents, time, rent, INR per minute and pulse shown before any credential, and unknowns stated. 140, 1600 and 1601 visible (0 of 6 show them). Goal: first Indian ring in 15 min or less on bring-your-own or pre-provisioned lines.
comparison.evidence: WT sarvam 23, bolna 25 and 36 [O]; WT §2.12; W7 in research/2026-10-20/teardown/synthesis/where-we-win.json

comparison.their_best: 140xx with DLT, 1600 via a VNO licence, a call-type field, Mumbai hosting, big-4 carriers
comparison.vp_better_how: Rides Exotel, Plivo and Vobiz as bring-your-own rails, with a code router that refuses a wrong-series CLI and shows 30 s pulse costs. Exotel's bot path enforces no windows or opt-out.

comparison.their_best: Blocking campaign.predial webhook; error or timeout means no call
comparison.vp_better_how: A built-in gate with 12 ordered checks inside the claim write on every path, a reason code per block, plus the same optional tenant hook that fails closed

comparison.their_best: Typed dnd_request closing tool and DLT fields
comparison.vp_better_how: Opt-out is written in the same transaction, tenant-wide, carried to every campaign and API path, never cleared by import, and graded by carrier CDRs. Pass bar: 0 rings on opt-out rows (W1, T9b).

comparison.their_best: Multi-range windows with days of week; Asia/Calcutta default in the dashboard
comparison.vp_better_how: Windows derived from the category (promotional 10:00-21:00 hard), absolute quiet hours 22:00-07:00, RBI 08:00-19:00 pack, the person's requested time, and a start cutoff. T3 pass bar: promotional 09:30 refused.

comparison.their_best: Nothing; Exotel says voice needs no DLT
comparison.vp_better_how: A pack export with a countdown, status per CLI, and a dial gate on undeclared CLIs from 2026-11-17

comparison.their_best: Nothing; campaigns only carry a call-type label (Exotel)
comparison.vp_better_how: compile() drops offer facts from service briefs and the reply door blocks offer lines. T9a pass bar: 0 spoken.

comparison.their_best: An 'AI Disclosure When Asked' preset on dashboard-created agents
comparison.vp_better_how: Non-removable on every creation path: a first-breath clause from data, checked as heard by playback marks, a denial blocker, and a T9c lint refusing 'say you are human'. Pass bar: 0 denials.
comparison.evidence: RAP-19/20 [O]; Sarvam 6/6 human claims [M]; Vapi 1 clear of 8 [M]; HV law 10

comparison.their_best: Sentiment Crash and Repetition Loop alerts, with a human able to barge in
comparison.vp_better_how: A crisis predicate gives 14416 and 112, suspends the goal, alerts the Supervisor within 30 s, and holds further calls for review; all in a visible safety inbox
comparison.evidence: Exotel dossier dim 1; voice-module R5; req-48

comparison.their_best: AMD beta, result 3-5 s after answer (account-manager enabled)
comparison.vp_better_how: Indian operator-announcement lexicon (Hindi and English in v1, 8 more in v2) with early exit, reason code and billed seconds shown. Target: median 4 s, 5/5 on T4.

comparison.their_best: Cold, Warm and Agentic Warm in plain words, with caller ID choice
comparison.vp_better_how: A spoken Hinglish or English brief under 15 s plus a hand-off card; verified destinations only; a callback if no answer in 25 s; IRDAI persuasion routed to a named certified human
comparison.evidence: retell 08 [O]; ACB (Bolna 2 s sleep, no summary); REG-26/27

comparison.their_best: Truecaller verify per number and trunk health columns
comparison.vp_better_how: Pacing and pausing against the operator's reg 21A signals (recipient diversity, short calls, in:out ratio), ramps for new lines, and sticky CLI per contact with no evasion rotation

comparison.their_best: Fixed Admin, Developer and Member roles on a free trial
comparison.vp_better_how: 5 fixed roles on every plan mapped to risk classes, and a hash-chained audit log naming VP's agents with the approval they acted under, reconciled nightly
comparison.evidence: retell 6z-roles [O]; WT §2.16 (no audit log seen at any of 6)

comparison.their_best: Per-agent authentication and a red open-allowlist warning
comparison.vp_better_how: Scoped keys with 90-day expiry and a per-key spend cap; widget keys closed until an origin is added; test keys reach verified phones only
comparison.evidence: elevenlabs 54 [O]; AS XS-26..28 (0 of 5 have a per-key cap)

comparison.their_best: 14 PII categories and storage and retention choices
comparison.vp_better_how: Aadhaar, PAN, bank and card redaction on by default with exemptions by provenance (14416, 112 never redacted); retention chosen at onboarding with sector minimums; deletion receipts read back

comparison.their_best: Mumbai hosting, region fixed at sign-up
comparison.vp_better_how: India storage by default, a per-call data passport of where each component ran, an India-only processing mode for BFSI, and masked India-hosted telemetry
comparison.evidence: EXO-19; SAR-63; EL-39; TS §5; R2R 2.1 (LIC RFP)

comparison.their_best: Trial calls only to verified numbers
comparison.vp_better_how: Missed-call verification plus a spoof-safe confirm call, friend invites, caps, and a global press-9 block (req-55)

comparison.their_best: Nothing; SquadStack's KPI rewards passing as human
comparison.vp_better_how: No OTP or payment on the call, links only on verified brand domains, refund and bonus framing blocked, know-your-business checks, a verify page and callback verify

comparison.their_best: Bolna fails over the LLM only; 9 of 18 incidents were upstream telephony
